stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image specification unavailable; CPU GNU/OpenMPI/FFTW baseline has no CUDA dependency. Published recipe uses linux/amd64 Ubuntu Jammy and Python 3.10. Library ABI, dependencies and source repairs untested. No build/workload run.

Input files not copied into temporary stage directory

resources.reason: Inventory includes overlapping archives and extracted-file downloads. Active data residency and peak memory unmeasured. Test archive uncompressed bytes 730945215 from brief; full training corpus unnecessary.

scoring_rules.interface: PINDER evaluator per-pose CSV, followed by explicit DockQ >= 0.23 aggregation
scoring_rules.caution: Published leaderboard acceptable columns use CAPRI_rank classification, not direct DockQ >= 0.23. Preserve both definitions; do not equate them.
scoring_rules.tolerance_policy: References retain null tolerance; uncertainty never used as tolerance.

repeatability.seed_reason: Brief requires independent seeds but specifies no seed list; none invented. Published FroDock adapter exposes no seed argument. Stochastic method seed protocol unresolved.
repeatability.candidate_count_basis: Fixed local calibration choice, informed by published Top 5 reporting; not claimed published FroDock run configuration.
repeatability.case_selection: Fixed paired-apo example in published preprocessing test; broader 93-case evaluation remains separate.
repeatability.mirror_identity: unverified_mirror; local SHA-256 pins bytes, not identity with original study. Published-value agreement cannot resolve material identity.
repeatability.aav_limit: Separated experimental components support redocking only; no independently determined unbound claim. No BBB, affinity or therapeutic inference.
